input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly.
input.rationale: Fees are purely usage-based on monthly notional volume, with no minimum volume, take-or-pay or shortfall payment; the only fixed amounts are the USD 35,000 initial payment and the USD 2,500 monthly support fee, which are not volume commitments. The 33% share of certain third-party revenues (Article V) is a revenue share rather than a purchase commitment.

input.quote: Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: Article XXI runs one way: our licence ends immediately and we must return everything within five days, with no transition assistance and no obligation on Licensor to return our trade and account data. We inserted a transition-assistance and data-return paragraph (six months' assistance, export within 30 days, certified deletion).
